text:
carla: Deploy bot flagged a hold on canary promotion — 3/5 staging canaries failing integration-tests: `db-migration-smoke` with connection timeout and namespace collision. deploy-bot: "promotion paused for tag=release-2026.03.08, reason=integration-tests/db-migration-smoke x3 failures"

devops-oncall: seeing the same in CI logs, runner 17 shows repeated >30s waits to create test DB namespace, then retry loop.

alex: logs look like this: ```
ERROR: failed to create namespace test-run-678: already exists
Caused by: transient lease collision when parallel test instances re-used namespace prefix
Traceback: timeout creating DB schema for migration step 001_create_users
```

ben: hmm could also be the ephemeral Redis cache TTL is too short so migration lock expires and two runners try to apply concurrently. Any recent kube-controller changes?

sre-monica: No kube changes in last 24h. I pulled the runner logs — there are a bunch of inode errors on the ephemeral runner FS around the same time, possible overlayfs race during workspace restore: `overlay: failed to apply diff` followed by `mkdir test-run-678: file exists`.

release-mgr: We have a change window ending in 2 hours. If we don't unblock, we need to pin back to last-good image for production cut. What's the impact if we pin?

alex: Pinning to release-2026.03.01 would let prod cut proceed but will block the rollout of the new telemetry changes. Also means re-running a subset of canaries later.

carla: Options: 1) manual promote previous image (fast, safe); 2) force rerun canaries with cache-bust (CI param) and serialized test-namespaces (slower); 3) abort cut and extend change window (ops overhead). Thoughts?

ben: I'm leaning pin+followup. We can't risk partial rollout with flaky DB migration. If we pin, we should add a release note line and open an incident for runner overlayfs corruption investigation.

sre-monica: Agreed. I can attach a quick mitigation: add `CI_PARALLEL_NAMESPACE=false` and `RUNNER_CACHE_CLEAR=true` to a re-run and see if serialization avoids the collision. But that will add ~20m to canary time.

deploy-bot: automatic suggestion: `pin_previous_image` recommended when canary pass rate < 80% or unknown infra errors detected.

release-mgr: Decision: pin to release-2026.03.01 for the production cut, document in release notes: "Pinned due to flaky staging DB migration; follow-up investigation and re-roll planned." I'll file follow-ups and schedule a rerun of canaries outside the change window at 0900 UTC tomorrow. Who will own the follow-up?

carla: I will own the follow-up ticket and coordinate with SRE for runner logs. ben, can you draft the release-note blurb?

ben: Posted note draft in #release-notes-drafts. blurb: "Production cut pinned to 2026.03.01 after staging DB migration instability; rollback/fix planned — see ENG-3472 for details."

sre-monica: I'll create an incident ticket ENG-3472 and attach runner diagnostics. Next immediate steps: 1) release-mgr to trigger pin via deploy-bot (manual promote prev image), 2) SRE to collect full runner overlay diffs, 3) Dev to prepare serialized rerun recipe.

release-mgr: Triggering manual promote now. deploy-bot: `promote --image=release-2026.03.01 --reason=\"canary-db-migration-failures\"`

deploy-bot: Promotion queued. Will report back on completion. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

devops-oncall: After pin, can we also temporarily disable parallel canary builds (CI_PARALLEL=0) to reduce blast radius for tomorrow's rerun?

release-mgr: yes, we will set that for the scheduled rerun.

deploy-bot: Promotion complete. Production tag now points to release-2026.03.01. :white_check_mark:

carla: Thanks — creating ENG-3472 now and adding logs + action items. We'll reconvene tomorrow after rerun. :spiral_calendar:

alex: FYI, I added a small patch to runner workspace restore logic to our staging branch to stop reusing namespace prefixes; will open a PR and reference ENG-3472.

ben: leaving a note to update release notes post-mortem with the final RCA.

sre-monica: adding monitoring alert to catch overlayfs apply failures in the runners (threshold > 2 in 10m).

carla: thread summary: manual pin applied to unblock change window; follow-up ENG-3472 created (owner: carla); rerun planned 0900 UTC tomorrow with serialized namespaces and cache-bust; SRE investigating runner overlayfs issue. Close thread when ENG-3472 updated. :lock:
